title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 13: The Message Spreads

scenes.say: A youth center in Newark asks him to speak for ten minutes.
scenes.visual: a small community center gym with folding chairs, afternoon light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He's survived war and cancer. Public speaking scares him more.
scenes.visual: a man waiting nervously in a hallway holding a microphone, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Thirty kids. Arms crossed. Hoods up. He sees himself in every one.
scenes.visual: rows of teenagers in hoodies sitting in folding chairs, seen from behind the speaker, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He doesn't give them a speech. He gives them the truth.
scenes.visual: a man standing in front of a small crowd, talking with his hands, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The courtroom. The convoy. The cancer. The comeback.
scenes.visual: a projected photo of a soldier on a wall behind a speaker, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ten minutes turns into an hour.
scenes.visual: a clock on a gym wall, hands moving, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: When he's done, one kid stays behind.
scenes.visual: an empty row of chairs with one teenager still sitting, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Mister, can I get that book?
scenes.visual: a teenager holding a book with both hands, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: That night, three more schools call.
scenes.visual: a phone screen lighting up on a table, multiple missed calls, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Turn negative into positive. It started as his story. Now it's a movement.
scenes.visual: a crowd of young people raising their hands in a gym, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Fourteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a microphone on a stand under a single spotlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 13 of 25: The Message Spreads. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
